base.scope: The introducing commit changes 15 files. The case holds the file the fix touched and its test. The commit's source changes in the four cognitive-routing and runtime sources total about 204 lines, under the 250-line limit, but the other three files hold no part of the defect and the requirements cover only the switch tool. Generated pi-extension/dist files are omitted; the repository's build (npm run build:pi-extension) reproduces the committed tool.js exactly, and the tests were run on that build output.
